qualityReasoning: The theme config is the main problem: cta-a/cta-b colors (#017a07 vs #018008), border radii (33px vs 34px), and three pairs of spacing values are all near-duplicates that differ by 1px or a barely perceptible color shift. These should almost certainly have been a single shared token set (one color, one radius, one spacing scale) rather than eight bespoke keys duplicated per button — this is exactly the redundant-token anti-pattern. On top of that, the two CTA links share an identical structural recipe (inline-block, padding, margin-top, rounded, bg, text-white, underline) but use entirely separate class names for every value instead of extracting a shared '.cta-btn' component class with only the differing color/spacing pulled out, so there's no reuse at all despite the near-identical markup. The HTML itself is short and syntactically clean, but that doesn't offset the theme bloat and copy-pasted-with-no-abstraction button markup.
